head_coach.name: Vincenzo Montella
head_coach.play_style_summary: Montella employs a possession-based, high-tempo, and technically fluid style. The team relies on winger-focused overloads, frequent positional rotations, and rapid attacking transitions. Under his guidance, Türkiye plays with high energy, often squeezing opponents with a compact 4-4-2 mid-block when defending and utilizing a strong counter-press immediately after losing possession.

key_players.name: Arda Güler
key_players.performance_stats: Recorded 6 goals and 14 assists in 50 matches for Real Madrid. Features elite pass completion, high chance creation (12 chances created in World Cup Qualifiers), and exceptional crossing accuracy.

key_players.name: Kenan Yıldız
key_players.performance_stats: Recorded 11 goals and 9 assists for Juventus. Highly versatile forward noted for progressive ball-carries, high dribble success rates, and active contribution to high-press recovery.

key_players.name: Can Uzun
key_players.performance_stats: Scored 8 goals and provided 4 assists in 21 Bundesliga appearances for Eintracht Frankfurt. Characterized by high shot conversion rates, intelligent off-the-ball runs, and strong spatial awareness.
